about: What the landscape picker says about each base landscape (intro screen, web and native). Ids stay as saved; mountains is shown as Steppe. `trait` is the one real difference today and must match the weights in sky-events.json `biomes`: weather odds and aurora chance, a small change to how you play. Landscape never locks any gameplay. Keep every trait to one short line so all cards share one layout.
heading: Choose where to build
lede: Your launch complex and everything you add will stand here.
note: Your landscape shifts the weather and sky you play under. You can move your base once later.
